id: 32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui
title: 安全员十问：施工安全基础（国内版）
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/32_Safety Quiz for Safety Officer Test Your Safety Knowledge Safety Quiz Safety Qui（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
points.K7: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
points.S2: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损

shots.scene: 欣欣站在讲台前，背后是空白投影幕
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lecture podium in front of a blank projection screen and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 安全员培训课：十道基础题！
overlay: 安全员十问：施工安全基础

shots.scene: 一排图标：监管徽章、坠落、沟槽、灭火器、锁
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a badge, a falling person, a trench, a fire extinguisher and a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 监管、坠落、开挖、消防、上锁。

shots.scene: 小研坐在教室里，桌上是空白的安全员培训手册
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits in a classroom with a blank safety officer training handbook on the desk.
shots.narration: 小研要当实验室安全员，来上培训课。

shots.scene: 王老师在讲台上举起空白题卡
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank quiz card at the front of the classroom.
shots.narration: 王老师说：先测一测，看哪块不熟。

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 题卡上四个选项框，下面一个灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A quiz card with four empty option boxes and a light bulb icon below. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题，每题四选一，答完讲原因。
overlay: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 放大镜照着一个空白的问号区域
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier hovers over a blank area marked with a question mark on a skills chart. No people.
shots.narration: 目的是找出自己的薄弱环节。

shots.scene: 原题图标：一个外国机构徽章
shots.prompt_en: A generic government badge icon with a globe behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：考的是监管机构的名称。

shots.scene: 王老师指着两个国内部门图标：盾牌和红十字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at two icons: a safety shield and a health cross.
shots.narration: 国内安全生产由应急管理部门监管。

shots.scene: 红十字图标旁边是空白法规书
shots.prompt_en: A health cross icon beside a blank law book. No people.
shots.narration: 职业健康归卫生健康部门管。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三级图标
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons: a university building, a college building and a laboratory flask. No people.
shots.narration: 学校里还有三级管理，层层负责。

shots.scene: 四个图标：坠落、闪电、落物、夹手
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a falling person, a lightning bolt, a falling object and hands caught between rollers. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：施工四大致命伤害。

shots.scene: 化学品瓶图标被单独放在一边
shots.prompt_en: A chemical bottle icon is set apart from the four hazard icons with a small note mark. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物质接触很重要，但不在这四类。

shots.scene: 沟槽里放着一个钢制支护箱
shots.prompt_en: A steel trench box placed inside a narrow trench, supporting both walls. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：沟槽支护箱干什么用？

shots.scene: 放工具、遮阳、挡雨图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A toolbox, a sun umbrella and a rain cloud icon, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 撑住沟壁防坍塌，保护沟里的人。

shots.scene: 汽油桶旁的火焰
shots.prompt_en: A closed fuel can beside a flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：易燃液体火用哪类灭火器？

shots.scene: B 类液体火卡片被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A liquid fire class card with a droplet and flame is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: B类，适用于汽油、油类火灾。

shots.scene: 灭火器标签上的适用火灾图标
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a blank extinguisher label with small fire class pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 用前看标签，适用类别要对上。

shots.scene: 地下检修口和一张空白审批单
shots.prompt_en: An open underground hatch beside a blank permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：有限空间何时要进入许可？

shots.scene: 原题答案卡：只在有危险气体时
shots.prompt_en: An answer card with a gas cloud icon and a question mark over it. No people.
shots.narration: 原题说：有危险气体时才需要。

shots.scene: 王老师摇头，在审批单上画勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator shakes her head and ticks a blank permit form.
shots.narration: 国内有限空间作业，一律先审批。

shots.scene: 三步图标：风机、检测仪、作业人员
shots.prompt_en: Three step icons joined by arrows: a fan, a gas detector and a worker. No people.
shots.narration: 先通风、再检测、后作业。

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 空白防坠落计划书，封面画着护栏
shots.prompt_en: A blank plan booklet with a guardrail icon on the cover. No people.
shots.narration: 第六题：防坠落计划为了什么？
overlay: 防坠落计划为了不坠落

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 急救、上报、调查图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A first aid icon, a report icon and a magnifier icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 首要目的是不让人掉下来。

shots.section_title: 防坠落计划为了不坠落
shots.scene: 护栏、安全带、作业步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a guardrail, a harness and a step-by-step list. No people.
shots.narration: 写清措施、装备和程序。

shots.scene: 老李在工地开班前会
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gives a short morning briefing to workers in hard hats before work starts.
shots.narration: 第七题：班前会什么时候开？

shots.scene: 半年日历、新人图标、新项目图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A half-year calendar, a new worker icon and a new project icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是半年一次，也不是只开一回。

shots.scene: 每天的日历格子都打勾
shots.prompt_en: A weekly calendar with a check mark on every working day. No people.
shots.narration: 每个工作日或班次开始前都开。

shots.scene: 王老师区分两张卡：入职教育和班前会
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds two different blank cards, one with a graduation cap icon and one with a sunrise icon.
shots.narration: 新人入职教育，是另一回事。

shots.scene: 老李给设备电闸上锁并挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer locks a power switch with a padlock and hangs a blank tag on it.
shots.narration: 第八题：上锁挂牌为了什么？

shots.scene: 电、气、液压三个能量图标被锁住
shots.prompt_en: Three energy icons, electricity, compressed air and hydraulics, each shown with a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 隔离能量源，防止检修时意外启动。

shots.scene: 防盗、管交通的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A night-time burglar icon and a traffic cone icon, both crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 不是防盗，也不是管交通。

shots.scene: 一份多页的空白说明书和化学品瓶
shots.prompt_en: A blank multi-page data sheet next to a chemical bottle with hazard pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：化学品数据表是什么？

shots.scene: 小研翻阅说明书，指着急救一节
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the data sheet and points to a section with a first aid icon.
shots.narration: 讲清性质、危害、防护和急救。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开国家标准
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank standards book.
shots.narration: 国内叫安全技术说明书，按国标编写。

shots.scene: 沟槽截面，两侧做成斜坡
shots.prompt_en: A trench cross-section with both sides cut into slopes. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：开挖放坡是什么？

shots.scene: 装饰、绿化、刷漆图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A decoration icon, a plant icon and a paint brush icon, all crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 把沟壁做成斜坡，防止塌方。

shots.scene: 空白施工方案和土质图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank construction plan beside soil type icons. No people.
shots.narration: 坡度多大，按土质和方案定。

shots.section_title: 测验目的：找出薄弱环节
shots.scene: 小研对照答案，在弱项上画圈
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks her answers and circles two weak topics in her notebook.
shots.narration: 小研圈出弱项，回去重点复习。

shots.scene: 破碎的烧杯和流血的手指图标
shots.prompt_en: A broken beaker on a bench and a bandaged finger icon. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，最常见的是玻璃割伤。

shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare hands picking up glass shards is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 碎玻璃别徒手捡。

shots.scene: 阿杰用扫帚簸箕收集，倒进专用碎玻璃盒
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sweeps glass shards with a brush and dustpan into a labeled broken glass box.
shots.narration: 用扫帚夹子，放进专用碎玻璃盒。

shots.scene: 小研检查烧瓶口有没有裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student inspects the rim of a flask for cracks before use.
shots.narration: 用前查裂纹，有缺口的不用。

shots.section_title: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 阿杰一个接一个拧开几十个离心管盖，手腕酸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student twists open dozens of tube caps one after another and rubs his sore wrist.
shots.narration: 几十个瓶盖拧下来，手腕最受罪。
overlay: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损

shots.section_title: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 改用开盖器和多管架
shots.prompt_en: The young male student uses a cap opener tool and a multi-tube rack instead.
shots.narration: 用开盖器、多孔架，少拧一下是一下。

shots.section_title: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 两人轮换操作，中途甩手休息
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student take turns, one shaking out his hands during a break.
shots.narration: 两人轮换，中途歇一歇。

shots.section_title: 批量拧瓶盖防手腕劳损
shots.scene: 欣欣做手腕伸展
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot demonstrates a gentle wrist stretch.
shots.narration: 手腕持续疼痛，要及时就医。

shots.scene: 一排图标：盾牌、四类伤害、支护箱、锁、说明书
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a shield, a four-part hazard icon, a trench box, a padlock and a data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 认监管、防四害、撑沟壁、会上锁。

shots.scene: 审批单和班前会两张图
shots.prompt_en: Two images side by side: a ticked permit form and a morning briefing icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有限空间先审批，班前会天天开。

shots.scene: 小研戴上安全员袖标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a blank safety officer armband and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研通过培训，当上了安全员。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the podium.
shots.narration: 弄懂每道题，安全记心里！
